categories.name: أَفْعَالُ الْإِعْرَاضِ وَالِانْصِرَافِ
categories.nameEn: Verbs meaning to turn away or turn back in the Qur'an

items.verse: ٱتَّبِعْ مَآ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
items.verseEn: Follow, [O Muḥammad], what has been revealed to you from your Lord - there is no deity except Him - and turn away from those who associate others with Allāh.
Have you seen the one who turned away

items.verse: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ زِدْنَـٰهُمْ عَذَابًۭا فَوْقَ ٱلْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يُفْسِدُونَ
items.verseEn: Those who disbelieved and averted [others] from the way of Allāh - We will increase them in punishment over [their] punishment for what corruption they were causing.
And they [i.e., Pharaoh and his people] were overcome right there and became debased.

categories.name: أَلْفَاظُ الزَّمَنِ وَالتَّقْدِيمِ
categories.nameEn: Words denoting time and temporal order

items.verse: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
items.verseEn: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.

items.verse: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلرِّجْزَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ هُم بَـٰلِغُوهُ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ
items.verseEn: But when We removed the punishment from them until a term which they were to reach, then at once they broke their word.
This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].

items.verse: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
items.verseEn: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know
And when Hellfire is set ablaze
But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

categories.name: أَدْوَارٌ وَمِهَنٌ بَشَرِيَّةٌ
categories.nameEn: Human occupations, titles and social roles

items.verseEn: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?

items.verse: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
items.verseEn: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?

items.verse: قَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَتَقُولُونَ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَكُمْ ۖ أَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَا وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّـٰحِرُونَ
items.verseEn: Moses said, "Do you say [thus] about the truth when it has come to you? Is this magic? But magicians will not succeed."

items.verse: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
items.verseEn: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
